When Emma Watson signed on to play Belle, she was heavily involved in updating the character for a modern, live-action audience, starting specifically with her wardrobe. She adamantly refused to wear a corset under any of her costumes, including the iconic yellow ballgown, arguing that an active, inventive woman like Belle wouldn’t wear something that physically restricted her breathing or movement. Watson also worked closely with the costume department to replace Belle’s delicate ballet flats from the animated film with sturdy, practical riding boots so she could realistically run and ride a horse. She even insisted that her blue village dress be designed with large, utilitarian pockets specifically so she would always have a place to carry her books.

Beauty and the Beast (2017), directed by Bill Condon, starring Emma Watson, Dan Stevens, Luke Evans, Josh Gad, Kevin Kline. A live-action adaptation of the classic Disney animated film, following an independent, book-loving young woman who takes her father’s place as a prisoner in an enchanted castle, slowly falling in love with the cursed prince hidden beneath a terrifying exterior.
